name: Study Agent

props.text: Enter a topic. Configure an OpenAI model and API key below; Send uses your API account.

imports:
# Reuse the asynchronous built-in client; only an explicit button sends text.
def study_send(app):
    topic = app.Topic.get().strip()
    if not topic or len(topic) > 2000:
        messagebox.showerror('Study Agent','Enter a topic (1-2000 characters).',parent=app.Form1)
        return
    prompt = ('Act as a patient study tutor. Explain the topic in clear steps, give one worked example, '
              'then ask three practice questions. Do not claim to have checked external sources. Topic: '+topic)
    app.Tutor.send(prompt)
startup:
# Configure a model and session key in the client before sending; startup is offline.
self.Form1.deiconify()
